search_jobs.description: Search BOSS Zhipin job listings and extract the cards. Read-only: it never sends a greeting or applies. Requires a headed browser with a logged-in session; an anonymous profile is redirected to an anti-bot security page.

query.description: Job keyword, e.g. 产品经理.

city.description: City code used by zhipin, e.g. 101020100 for Shanghai. Defaults to Shanghai.

maxJobs.description: How many cards to collect. One page holds 15.

returns.description: Object with {jobs, blocked, hint}. jobs is an array of {name, salary, tags, company, location, url}; salary is null when the page renders '-K'. blocked is true when the anti-bot page was served.
